referenceRoleGuidance.label: Subject reference guidance
referenceRoleGuidance.text: Use these references for the selected subject's recognizable identity, silhouette, poses and expressions. When outfit references are selected, let them control clothing and accessories; preserve this subject when scenery or style changes. Pose and expression examples are inspiration only and do not guarantee unsupported animation.

referenceRoleGuidance.label: Character reference guidance
referenceRoleGuidance.text: Use these references for the selected character's recognizable identity, silhouette, poses and expressions. When outfit references are selected, let them control clothing and accessories; preserve this character when scenery or style changes. Pose and expression examples are inspiration only and do not guarantee unsupported animation.

referenceRoleGuidance.label: Outfit reference guidance
referenceRoleGuidance.text: Use these references for the selected clothing, colors, accessories and outfit details. Apply them to the selected subject without copying a depicted model's identity, face, body, pose or background. Outfit references supersede incidental clothing in other references.

referenceRoleGuidance.label: City and scenery reference guidance
referenceRoleGuidance.text: Use these references for buildings, landmarks, streets, landscape and environmental mood. Do not transfer depicted people, clothing or an incidental visual style onto the selected subject, outfit or style.

referenceRoleGuidance.label: Style reference guidance
referenceRoleGuidance.text: Use these references for visual treatment while preserving the selected subject, outfit and environment. Retain the selected style when outfit or scenery references change.

referenceRoleGuidance.label: Complete scene reference guidance
referenceRoleGuidance.text: Use the selected complete scene as finished artwork. Preserve its identity, outfit, style, composition and drawn details exactly; prompts describe motion only. A changed appearance requires replacement external artwork rather than redrawing, restyling or inpainting this picture.

standardGuidelines.text: Keep requested subjects and characteristics recognizable from the selected references.
Keep intended objects coherent and avoid unintended visual artifacts.
Maintain temporal stability and continuity where the request calls for continuity.

motionGuidelines.text: Animate the supplied finished artwork without redesigning its subjects, outfit, style, scenery or composition and without generating a replacement still image.
